mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", product_code AS "productCode", order_qty AS "orderQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty", note AS "note", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate", source_order_id AS "sourceOrderId", COALESCE(is_stock_production, 0) AS "isStockProduction", lot_no AS "lotNo", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_material_substitution s WHERE s.schedule_id = production_schedule.id) AS "substitutionCount" FROM production_schedule WHERE schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", product_code AS "productCode", order_qty AS "orderQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty", note AS "note", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate", source_order_id AS "sourceOrderId", lot_no AS "lotNo", COALESCE(ship_confirmed, 0) AS "shipConfirmed" FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE production_schedule SET client_code = #{clientCode}, product_code = #{productCode}, order_qty = #{orderQty}, note = #{note}, logistics_date = #{logisticsDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE name = #{clientName} AND client_code IS NOT NULL AND client_code != '' ORDER BY client_code LIMIT 1

SELECT code FROM products WHERE name = #{displayName} OR (spec IS NOT NULL AND spec != '' AND (name || '(' || spec || ')' = #{displayName} OR name || ' (' || spec || ')' = #{displayName})) ORDER BY code LIMIT 1

SELECT material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent" FROM bom WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND material_code IS NOT NULL AND ratio_percent IS NOT NULL

SELECT from_material_code AS "fromMaterialCode", from_material_name AS "fromMaterialName", to_material_code AS "toMaterialCode", to_material_name AS "toMaterialName", reason AS "reason" FROM production_material_substitution WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_material_usage (schedule_id, material_code, material_name, qty_used, created_at) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{qtyUsed,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT b.material_code AS "materialCode", COALESCE(m.name, b.material_name) AS "materialName", b.ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent" FROM bom b LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.product_code = #{productCode} AND b.material_code IS NOT NULL AND b.ratio_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.ratio_percent DESC

SELECT id AS "id", order_date AS "orderDate", production_date AS "productionDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = sales_order.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_order.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty", note AS "note", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate", COALESCE(is_stock_production, 0) AS "isStockProduction" FROM sales_order WHERE production_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND COALESCE(imported_production, 0) = 0 ORDER BY production_date, sort_order, id
